x: The 1960 Club dinner will be held at the Ardington Rooms, Clapham Junction, on Nov 5th. Tickets at 21/-each can be obtained from A.T.Jordan 28, Devonshire Ave., Sheerwater, Woking, or from C.T.CARTER, J.W.GOSWELL, R.
Dancing was underway by 9pm, and the tinkling of glasses and merriment of the company continued in full swing until midnight. Thus ended one of the most successful Club dinners ever----thanks to A.T.
